title: Part 1 force range
description: Essential: Correctly states the range 2 N < F ≤ 4 N for combined uniform acceleration.

title: Part 2 acceleration
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the acceleration of A as 0.5 m/s² when F = 3 N.

title: Part 2 friction force
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the friction force from B on A as 2.5 N when F = 3 N.

title: Part 3 time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time for B to reach the end as √2 s (≈1.414 s) when F = 5 N.

title: Relative motion analysis
description: Important: Identifies the condition for no slipping between A and B using maximum static friction.

title: Free-body diagrams
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law separately to block B and board A with correct force identification.

title: Ground friction calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the kinetic friction between board A and ground as μ₁(M+m)g = 2 N.

title: Relative acceleration setup
description: Optional: Sets up the relative acceleration equation for part 3 correctly (a_B - a_A = relative acceleration).

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong direction for friction forces on free-body diagrams or in equations of motion.

title: Incorrect friction pairing
description: Pitfall: Confuses which friction coefficient applies to which interface (A-ground vs. A-B).
